news.headline: Tulane names a new starting quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that Kadin Semonza will start Saturday against South Alabama. Semonza came off the bench at halftime at Duke and led Tulane's only scoring drive.

news.headline: Tulane's coach says the mistakes can be fixed
news.summary: Will Hall took the blame for the offense after Saturday's 17-3 loss at Duke. Tulane was flagged for 15 penalties, and Hall changed quarterbacks at halftime.

news.headline: Duke beats Tulane 17-3 in the opener
news.summary: Tulane's offense never got going Saturday at Duke and the Green Wave managed only a field goal. Duke running back Nate Sheppard carried the ball 35 times for 227 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Florida's game with Campbell is sold out
news.summary: Every ticket is gone for Saturday afternoon's game in Gainesville. It is the 20th home game in a row the Gators have sold out.

news.headline: Florida will wear blue helmets Saturday
news.summary: The Gators announced Thursday that they will wear blue helmets, orange jerseys and white pants against Campbell. They have not worn the blue helmets since 2020.

news.headline: Sumrall wants a cleaner game from the Gators
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that his defense was not sharp in the 66-21 win over Florida Atlantic. He also said the bad snaps from his center will get fixed before Campbell visits on Saturday.

news.headline: Texas is No. 4 and hosts No. 1 Ohio State
news.summary: The new Associated Press poll came out Tuesday with Ohio State first and Texas fourth. The two teams play Saturday night in Austin.

news.headline: Texas running back Derrek Cooper is in a boot
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Cooper hurt his ankle in Saturday's win over Texas State and is wearing a walking boot. Cooper will miss the Ohio State game, and Sarkisian did not say how long he will be out.

news.headline: Texas lineman Cole Hutson cannot play right now
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Hutson is not eligible because he went to two NFL tryout camps last spring. Texas is appealing to the NCAA, and Hutson has started 23 games for the Longhorns.

news.headline: Tyler Shough starts his second season as a captain
news.summary: Quarterback Tyler Shough is the starter again this year, and his teammates voted him one of the team captains. He now gives the speech in the huddle before games, a job Drew Brees used to have.

news.headline: Cam Jordan is out Sunday, Kamara is a maybe
news.summary: The Saints ruled out Cam Jordan, tight end Oscar Delp and running back Audric Estime for Sunday's opener at Detroit. Alvin Kamara is listed as questionable after he practiced fully on Friday.

news.headline: Travis Etienne will play his first game for the Saints
news.summary: Running back Travis Etienne sat out the preseason, so Sunday at Detroit will be his first game in a Saints uniform. He grew up in Jennings, Louisiana, and ran for more than 1,000 yards in three of his four seasons with Jacksonville.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference weekly award
news.summary: Concannon had 49 kills and 52 digs across four wins at IUP's home tournament last weekend. She leads the Crimson Hawks with 105 kills through nine matches.

news.headline: Bellinger homer lifts Yankees past the Mets
news.summary: Cody Bellinger hit a three-run home run in the second inning Friday night and the Yankees beat the Mets 6-4. New York is 85-62 and leads Boston by five and a half games for the first wild card spot.

news.headline: Chisholm goes on the injured list with a hurt thumb
news.summary: Jazz Chisholm sprained his thumb sliding into second base and will not play for at least a week. Jose Caballero is taking his place at second base.

news.headline: Volpe's grand slam finishes off a sweep
news.summary: Anthony Volpe hit a grand slam in the seventh inning Thursday night and drove in five runs in a 10-3 win. The Yankees swept all three games from Colorado and are now 84-62.
